about: IPO ExitIQ public prediction log. Committed to git BEFORE each IPO lists. The trustworthy timestamp is the time GitHub's servers received the push (repo Activity tab), not the locally-set commit date; the web page carrying these predictions is also archived on the Wayback Machine. After each listing, actuals are filled in — win or lose.
miss_definition: Tightened 2026-10-30, before any of the four listings resolved (original 2026-10-29 rule: opposite sign OR >15 points — preserved in git history). Primary target: listing-day CLOSE (open also recorded). Headline HIT = same sign AND |error| <= max(10 points, 50% of |headline|). The exact error in points is always reported. The AI model is scored separately: model_error_pts (running MAE) and prob_call (right if the actual sign matches prob_pct > 50).

predictions.note: Recorded while subscription was still open; final subscription figures may move the live verdict.

worked_examples_not_counted.note: Model replay built AFTER listing (the builder's own trade: 12 shares allotted at Rs 1,119, sold at Rs 1,358 = +21.4%). Shown as a worked example only — never counted in the scorecard.
